::: {.home-intro}

A record of what I'm reading, what I've finished, and what I thought along the way.

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)

source("R/reading_helpers.R")

# --------------------------------------------------
# Import the datasets
# --------------------------------------------------

books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    date_started = as.Date(date_started),
    date_finished = as.Date(date_finished)
  )

reading_log <- read_csv(
  "data/reading_log.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    book_id = col_character(),
    date = col_date(),
    page_reached = col_integer()
  )
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Retrieve the latest recorded progress
# --------------------------------------------------

latest_progress <- reading_log |>
  group_by(book_id) |>
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(book_id, page_reached)

home_books <- books |>
  left_join(latest_progress, by = "book_id") |>
  mutate(
    current_page = coalesce(
      page_reached,
      baseline_page
    )
  )

# --------------------------------------------------
# Calculate summary statistics
# --------------------------------------------------

books_finished <- sum(
  books$status == "Finished",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

books_reading <- sum(
  books$status == "Reading",
  na.rm = TRUE
)

pages_logged <- calculate_book_progress(
  books,
  reading_log
) |>
  summarise(
    total = sum(pages_read, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  pull(total)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Generate an individual book card
# --------------------------------------------------

book_card <- function(b, variant = "compact") {

  book_title <- b$title[[1]]
  author <- b$author[[1]]
  status <- b$status[[1]]
  total_pages <- b$total_pages[[1]]
  current_page <- b$current_page[[1]]

  # Determine the link to the book page
  page_path <- b$book_page[[1]]

  link <- if (
    is.na(page_path) || !nzchar(page_path)
  ) {
    NA_character_
  } else {
    sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", page_path)
  }

  # Make content clickable when a page exists
  make_link <- function(content) {
    if (is.na(link)) {
      content
    } else {
      tags$a(href = link, content)
    }
  }

  # Retrieve the cover from Open Library
  cover <- if (!is.na(b$cover_id[[1]])) {

    tags$img(
      src = paste0(
        "https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/",
        b$cover_id[[1]],
        "-L.jpg"
      ),
      alt = paste("Cover of", book_title),
      class = "book-cover",
      loading = "lazy"
    )

  } else {

    tags$div(
      class = "book-cover-placeholder",
      "Cover unavailable"
    )
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Create progress information
  # --------------------------------------------------

  details <- NULL

  if (
    status == "Reading" &&
    !is.na(current_page) &&
    !is.na(total_pages) &&
    total_pages > 0
  ) {

    progress <- round(
      100 * current_page / total_pages,
      1
    )

    progress <- max(0, min(100, progress))

    details <- tags$div(
      class = "book-progress",

      tags$div(
        class = "book-progress-track",
        role = "progressbar",
        `aria-label` = paste(
          "Reading progress for",
          book_title
        ),
        `aria-valuenow` = as.character(progress),
        `aria-valuemin` = "0",
        `aria-valuemax` = "100",

        tags$div(
          class = "book-progress-fill",
          style = paste0(
            "width: ", progress, "%;"
          )
        )
      ),

      tags$p(
        class = "book-progress-label",
        paste0(
          "Page ", current_page,
          " of ", total_pages,
          " · ", progress, "%"
        )
      )
    )

  } else if (status == "Reading") {

    details <- tags$p(
      class = "book-card-meta",
      "Reading progress not yet logged"
    )

  } else if (status == "Finished") {

    finished <- b$date_finished[[1]]

    finished_text <- if (is.na(finished)) {
      "Completion date not recorded"
    } else {
      paste(
        "Finished",
        format(finished, "%B %d, %Y")
      )
    }

    details <- tags$p(
      class = "book-card-meta",
      finished_text
    )

  } else {

    details <- tags$p(
      class = "book-card-meta",
      status
    )
  }

  # --------------------------------------------------
  # Construct the card
  # --------------------------------------------------

  tags$article(
    class = paste(
      "book-card",
      paste0("book-card--", variant)
    ),

    tags$div(
      class = "book-card-media",
      make_link(cover)
    ),

    tags$div(
      class = "book-card-content",

      tags$p(
        class = "book-card-eyebrow",
        if (status == "Reading") {
          "CURRENTLY READING"
        } else if (status == "Finished") {
          "COMPLETED"
        } else {
          toupper(status)
        }
      ),

      tags$h3(
        make_link(book_title)
      ),

      tags$p(
        class = "book-card-author",
        author
      ),

      details
    )
  )
}

# --------------------------------------------------
# Display groups of books
# --------------------------------------------------

show_books <- function(data, variant = "compact") {

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(
      tags$p(
        class = "empty-state",
        "No books to display yet."
      )
    )
  }

  cards <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(data)),
    function(i) {
      book_card(data[i, ], variant)
    }
  )

  container_class <- if (variant == "featured") {
    "featured-book-list"
  } else {
    "recent-book-grid"
  }

  do.call(
    tags$div,
    c(
      list(class = container_class),
      cards
    )
  )
}
```

## Currently Reading

```{r}
#| echo: false

home_books |>
  filter(status == "Reading") |>
  arrange(desc(date_started)) |>
  show_books(variant = "featured")
```


## Recently Completed

```{r}
#| echo: false

home_books |>
  filter(status == "Finished") |>
  arrange(desc(date_finished)) |>
  slice_head(n = 5) |>
  show_books(variant = "compact")
```
